verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's own docs say you sign in with a magic-link email instead of an API key. Your account carries a plan with usage windows you can check in the TUI, and upgrades apply to that signed-in plan without signing in again. Together these cover using the coding agent through your existing subscription. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the plan-based sign-in flow, detailed documentation of which plan tiers grant agent access and their limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: ByteAsk uses **magic-link email sign-in** - no API key required by default.
Shows your current plan and how much of each usage window you've spent.
Your plan is upgraded automatically once payment completes - no need to sign in again.
Your session now renews itself quietly at launch, well before it expires.
